reason: Expert explains that traffic getting stuck after SFP replacement is fixed in firmware 3.4, and the disable/enable workaround is only needed on older software.

knowledge.summary: On transmission nodes with firmware below 3.4, replacing an SFP can cause traffic to get stuck, requiring the interface to be disabled and enabled; this bug is fixed in firmware 3.4 and later.
knowledge.author: Erkki Expert
knowledge.details: Traffic gets stuck in the forwarding state after optics changes on firmware below 3.4.
